0c1e924baae3ecbc5fa96e88a1afd0d7d55e8b97.summary: Analysis of eight malicious container images in a Docker Hub account linked to the TeamTNT group. Two were used in attacks in the wild. The images carried crypto-mining tools, Mirai and Tsunami malware, a Docker escape binary and a bind shell. Later images added defense evasion, lateral movement and hidden command-and-control. The report says the campaign is still active and targets cloud native environments, especially misconfigured Docker API ports, and recommends dynamic analysis before deployment.
